player.seasonOutlook: Evans was selected by the Panthers in the fifth round of April's draft. He is a capable two-way tight end who peaked as a receiver with a 43-421-3 receiving line in 2024 at Notre Dame. It was a solid rebound after substantial missed action in 2022 (broken foot) and 2023 (torn ACL). Evans ran a solid 4.74 40-yard dash at 258 pounds at the combine. He'll likely slot in as the team's No. 3 tight end behind second-year Ja'Tavion Sanders and veteran Tommy Tremble.

Hawes was selected by the Bills in the fifth round of April's draft. He did a lot of blocking and produced only a 16-195-0 receiving line in 12 games (5% target share) last season, his lone campaign at Georgia Tech. He's unlikely to emerge as a consistent pass catcher in the pros.
